title: published-blogs document, schema version 2
description: One document per post in the Cosmos DB containers published-blogs and published-blogs-staging (partition key /id). Written only by the Blog Writer server; read by the portfolio build. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (id == slug, redirect target, timestamps not in the future, toc and media consistency with htmlContent, htmlContent inside sanitizer-profile.json, document size) are listed in contracts/README.md and enforced by blogwriter.publish.contract. Patterns are ECMA-262 with the u flag (Ajv's default).

id.description: Cosmos id and partition key. Always equal to slug: the portfolio point-reads item(slug, slug).

slug.description: URL slug (/blog/<slug>). Immutable once published: a rename writes a redirect stub under the old slug.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of this contract. Documents without it are v1 legacy documents.

status.description: published renders (once publishedAt has passed); redirect is a stub pointing at redirectTo; unpublished is a tombstone that renders nothing and keeps the slug reserved.

redirectTo.description: Slug of the document that replaces this one. Only for status redirect; never equal to id.

excerpt.description: Summary for listings, feeds and meta description fallbacks (v1 field).

htmlContent.description: Sanitized HTML fragment (no html/head/body wrapper) inside contracts/sanitizer-profile.json. Media references point at assets[].path (v1 field).

mdxContent.description: Canonical article-dialect Markdown (frontmatter and body) of the published version, at most 512 KiB of UTF-8. Kept for compatibility and export; readers render htmlContent, never this (v1 field).

sourceUrl.description: Optional primary source the post responds to (v1 field). Omitted when there is none; never an empty string.

sourceType.description: Optional origin label (v1 field), e.g. original or news-analysis.

publishedAt.description: First publication instant. Readers never render a document before this instant.

updatedAt.description: Last write instant (content change, correction, redirect or unpublish). Never earlier than publishedAt.

date.description: v1 compatibility only: the UTC calendar date of publishedAt. Readers use publishedAt.

tags.description: Tag slugs from the article frontmatter, in frontmatter order (may be empty).

pillar.description: Pillar id from the Library settings.

format.description: Format-pack id, e.g. case-study, framework, deep-explainer, news-analysis.

total.description: Omitted when unknown; otherwise at least part.

heroImage.description: Hero image (a typographic card by default). A site-relative url must be one of assets[].path.

allOf.description: a PNG file (.png): LinkedIn and X cannot render SVG Open Graph images

ogImage.description: 1200x630 PNG Open Graph image. A site-relative url must be one of assets[].path.

assets.description: Media the portfolio copies from the private Blob container published into public/blog-media (same origin). path is /blog-media/<id>/<file>, blob is <id>/<file> with the same file, sha256 is the hex digest of the blob bytes.

toc.description: Table of contents: every h2 and h3 of htmlContent that carries an id, in document order (may be empty).

citations.description: Sources cited by the article, in footnote order (may be empty). id is the brief source id used as the [^src-id] label.

corrections.description: Dated correction notes, oldest first (may be empty). Dates fall between the UTC dates of publishedAt and updatedAt.

canonicalUrl.description: Optional canonical URL when it is not the post's own URL.

seo.description: Optional overrides; readers fall back to title and excerpt.

^_(?:rid|self|etag|attachments|ts|lsn)$.description: Cosmos DB system properties, present on documents read back from the store. Writers never set them.

redirectTo.description: is only allowed when status is "redirect"

slug.description: lowercase kebab-case: words of [a-z0-9] joined by single hyphens

headingId.description: a heading id from htmlContent (lowercase kebab-case)

token.description: a lowercase token: words of [a-z0-9] joined by single hyphens or underscores

plainText.description: non-empty plain text on one line: no '<', no control characters or line breaks, no leading or trailing whitespace

text.description: non-empty text on one line ('<' allowed; readers escape it): no control characters or line breaks, no leading or trailing whitespace

body.description: document text: no NUL characters and no unpaired surrogates

utcTimestamp.description: a UTC instant with second precision, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (fixed width, so string order is time order)

partialDate.description: a date, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

httpsUrl.description: an absolute https:// URL without whitespace, backslashes or control characters

url.description: an https:// URL or a site-relative path starting with a single '/' (the sanitizer profile's src rule)

assetPath.description: /blog-media/<slug>/<file>, where file is lowercase [a-z0-9._-] with an image extension

sha256.description: a SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters
